svg.title: Plaid transactions: explicit import and refresh
svg.desc: Seven steps from account ownership checks through recurring signals, paginated fetching, filtering, categorization, per-row upserts, recurrence resolution and matching merchant-history backfill. Explicit user overrides win, then saved positive tags, Plaid signals, merchant flags and heuristics. Unavailable recurring signals produce a warning.

g.text: Plaid → filter and categorize → per-row database upsert
Explicit user import; access tokens remain on the server; no editable preview
1. Select accounts/dates; validate ownership
2. Fetch transactions in pages of 500
3. Filter; clean and identify merchants
History → exact name/alias → longest string → fuzzy → Proper Case
4. Resolve category; batch AI fallback
5. Upsert each accepted transaction
6. Continue selected pages / institutions
7. Resolve recurrence; backfill history
Authenticated user's stored Plaid institutions/accounts only
Fetch recurring signals too; warn if unavailable
Skip pending, transfers, non-USD and invalid data
User preference → merchant → Plaid category → AI IDs
Key: user + Plaid ID; protect user-edited classification
No whole-import database transaction or upload receipt
Overrides → saved tags → Plaid → profile → heuristics
More pages
or institutions
Keep unresolved rows as unassigned; overlapping Plaid IDs update existing records.
Unexpected database failure may leave earlier per-row writes committed.
Similar manual or uploaded transactions are not merged by this ID-based path.
